test_inputs.explanation: The execution trace only shows navigation to Magento's admin customer grid URLs without exposing concrete form values or menu selections. In this environment, the tool description states that the Magento admin login defaults to username 'admin' and password 'password123' when not otherwise specified, so those are the most realistic working credentials. The required parameters 'selection_mode' and 'action' must be set to valid enum values to successfully replay the tool; 'visible' and 'delete' represent a straightforward mass delete operation on the currently visible customers, which is consistent with typical admin mass-action usage. 'action_group' and 'filter_group' are optional and either ignored (for non-assign_group actions) or defaulted, so 'General' and 'Any' are chosen as neutral, valid values within their enums.
